boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Thomas Aquinas College
boards.description: Ten named Santa Paula food destinations with current operator-posted evening availability; confirm holiday hours before leaving campus.

cards.title: Jack in the Box
cards.subtitle: 306 S Palm Ave, Santa Paula
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need the latest verified option: the location page lists it through 4 a.m. daily, while lobby service ends earlier.
cards.short_summary: A Santa Paula drive-thru with the board’s latest posted availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box’s official Santa Paula location page lists drive-thru hours through 4:00 a.m. every day and a 10:00 p.m. lobby close.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 306 S Palm Ave, Santa Paula
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru service until 4:00 a.m. daily; lobby hours are 6:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Harvard Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 535 W Harvard Blvd, Santa Paula
cards.notes: Check the location page before heading out; it identifies this Harvard Boulevard restaurant as open until midnight and offers drive-thru service.
cards.short_summary: A named fast-food stop with official midnight availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Santa Paula locations page identifies the restaurant at 535 W Harvard Blvd as open until 12:00 a.m. and offering drive-thru service.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Santa Paula, California
cards.access_notes: Official Taco Bell location listing says this restaurant is open until 12:00 a.m.; verify day-specific and holiday timing before travel.

cards.title: Domino’s on North Ojai Road
cards.subtitle: 431 N Ojai Rd, Santa Paula
cards.notes: Use the store page to place a carryout or delivery order; it lists this Santa Paula location as open until midnight on the displayed day.
cards.short_summary: A pizza option whose official store page posts a midnight close.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page for 431 N Ojai Rd, Santa Paula lists the store as open until 12:00 a.m. on the displayed day.
cards.source_title: Domino’s Pizza — 431 N Ojai Rd, Santa Paula
cards.access_notes: Official store page displays ‘Open Today Until 12:00 AM’; its page also notes that location hours vary, so check before ordering.

cards.title: Tlaquepaque Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 120 S Mill St, Santa Paula
cards.notes: For a sit-down or takeout dinner, use the posted weekend window: the restaurant lists Saturday and Sunday service through 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Mexican restaurant with a documented 10 p.m. weekend close.
cards.evidence_claim: Tlaquepaque Restaurant’s official site lists weekend hours of 7:30 a.m.–10:00 p.m. and weekday hours through 9:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site posts Saturday–Sunday service until 10:00 p.m.; Monday–Friday service ends at 9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Enzo’s Italian Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 134 N Mill St, Santa Paula
cards.notes: Plan this as a Friday or Saturday dinner: Enzo’s official hotel page lists those nights from 5 to 10 p.m. and gives the dining phone number.
cards.short_summary: An Italian dinner room with a specifically posted late-week schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: The Glen Tavern Inn’s official dining page lists Enzo’s Italian Restaurant hours as 5:00–10:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Glen Tavern Inn — Enzo’s Italian Restaurant
cards.access_notes: Official dining page lists 5:00–10:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday; Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday hours end at 9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Parque 1055
cards.subtitle: 1055 E Main St, Santa Paula
cards.notes: Reserve or call ahead for a dinner outing; the restaurant’s dining page lists Friday and Saturday hours through 10 p.m. and other evenings through 9.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street dinner destination with posted 10 p.m. late-week service.
cards.evidence_claim: Parque 1055’s official dining page lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m., with Sunday–Thursday service through 9:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official dining page lists Friday and Saturday service until 10:00 p.m.; it also states summer Monday closures, so verify before travel.

cards.title: Ameci Pizza Kitchen
cards.subtitle: 125 E Harvard Blvd, Santa Paula
cards.notes: Order pickup from the Harvard Boulevard storefront when an evening pizza run fits the plan; its official ordering page posts daily hours through 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A pizza kitchen with operator-posted 10 p.m. availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Ameci Pizza Kitchen’s official Santa Paula ordering page lists hours of 10:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. at 125 E Harvard Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists 10:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; use its order flow or phone number to confirm availability.

cards.title: Round Table Pizza on Main Street
cards.subtitle: 598 W Main St, Santa Paula
cards.notes: Use the official order page for current pickup or delivery timing; it lists 10 p.m. closing on Friday and Saturday and 9:30 p.m. on other days.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street pizza option with documented late-week 10 p.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Round Table Pizza’s official Santa Paula ordering page lists Friday and Saturday hours through 10:00 p.m. and Sunday–Thursday hours through 9:30 p.m.
cards.source_title: Round Table Pizza — Santa Paula Ordering
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists Friday–Saturday hours until 10:00 p.m.; confirm whether pickup and delivery windows differ.

cards.title: Hozy’s Grill
cards.subtitle: 1760 E Lemonwood Dr, Santa Paula
cards.notes: Make this an early-evening dinner plan: the restaurant lists dinner Wednesday through Saturday from 5 to 9:30 p.m. and provides its address and phone.
cards.short_summary: A Lemonwood Drive dinner restaurant with posted 9:30 p.m. service.
cards.evidence_claim: Hozy’s Grill official site lists dinner Wednesday–Saturday from 5:00–9:30 p.m. at 1760 E Lemonwood Dr.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists dinner Wednesday–Saturday until 9:30 p.m.; daytime hours differ, so plan around the dinner schedule.

cards.title: Chapala Mexican Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 245 S 10th St, Santa Paula
cards.notes: Use the downtown address for an evening meal or takeout; Chapala’s official site posts 9 p.m. closing every day, with earlier weekend opening times.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown restaurant with consistently posted 9 p.m. closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Chapala Mexican Restaurant’s official Santa Paula site lists hours through 9:00 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists a 9:00 p.m. close Sunday–Saturday; verify operations before a late arrival.
